risk_if_not_implemented: Without Separation of Primary / Alternate Providers, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2), Sub-Tier / Fourth-Party Supply Chain Exposure (R-SC-3), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6). No threat is rated Likely for this control; threats rated Possible include Civil or Political Unrest (MT-1), Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Hazardous Materials Emergencies (MT-3).

compensating_control_1.name: Alternate Processing Site
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate processing site that provides processing capability and security measures equivalent to that of the primary site.
compensating_control_1.justification: Alternate Processing Site (BCD-13) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Separation of Primary / Alternate Providers (BCD-17.2) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Out-of-Band Channels
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize out-of-band channels for the electronic transmission of information and/or the physical shipment of system components or devices to authorized individuals.
compensating_control_2.justification: Out-of-Band Channels (NET-07) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Separation of Primary / Alternate Providers (BCD-17.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
